claims.statement: Rowwise collision budgets imply the aggregate collision budget.
Pointwise diagonal-plus-collision energy bounds and an aggregate collision budget imply the global weighted energy bound.
A row-indexed collision decomposition and rowwise budgets imply the global weighted energy bound.
The fixed-order pair caps aggregate by the exact hockey-stick identity.
The weighted additive-character energy equals the exact collision-kernel quadratic form.
Unrestricted nonnegative weights cannot uniformly force R_beta=o(D_beta), because a weight concentrated on one colliding modulus has R_beta>=D_beta.
For fixed order r and 0<=beta(q)q<=U_r, R_beta<=U_r*choose(n-1,r+1), hence E_beta(a)<=(D_beta+U_r*choose(n-1,r+1))*||a||_2^2.
The frozen actual squarefree source block has a collision norm sufficient for RUHL-FM or INT-SOCG.
All weighted squarefree-composite moduli required by the full source or connected decomposition are controlled.
